example.title: Christian Kupke farmstead (Farm at Long Lane), red outbuilding

brief: Compact frame granary-and-tool shed about 20 ft by 24 ft, sided in barn-red horizontal drop siding with some peeling paint, a single white-painted plank door on the long side, a steep gable roof of silver corrugated metal and a low whitewashed stone foundation. Tall grass and weeds grow up around it at the edge of a soybean field with a dense deciduous windbreak behind. (Granary/tool shed; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
